Create a breathtaking, ultra-photorealistic luxury bridal fashion film featuring an extraordinarily beautiful blonde bride wearing an intricately embroidered light green couture wedding gown and a magnificent cathedral-length veil.

The bride poses gracefully throughout the perfectly manicured gardens of a grand historic European castle. The film combines intimate beauty portraits, extreme macro shots of exquisite bridal craftsmanship, majestic architectural compositions, and elegant slow cinematic camera movements.

The atmosphere is ethereal, regal, romantic, expensive, and timeless, resembling a high-end European bridal couture campaign.

MAIN CHARACTER — STRICT IDENTITY CONSISTENCY

A stunning 24-year-old European woman @dp with delicate, symmetrical facial features, luminous fair skin, naturally rosy cheeks, striking pale-blue eyes, softly arched eyebrows, a slender straight nose, and naturally full pink lips. blush on her cheeks.

Her long golden-blonde hair is styled in an elegant, slightly loose bridal updo, with delicate wisps framing her cheeks and temples.

Her expression is serene, sophisticated, mysterious, and quietly confident.

Skin realism: Visible natural pores, subtle freckles, realistic skin translucency, natural peach fuzz, and gentle imperfections. Absolutely no plastic skin, excessive smoothing, porcelain appearance, or artificial CGI beauty.

Maintain exactly the same face, eye color, hairstyle, body proportions, and bridal outfit across every shot.

BRIDAL GOWN — STRICT WARDROBE CONSISTENCY

The bride wears an extraordinary custom-made light green couture wedding gown inspired by European royal bridal fashion.

Bodice details:

Structured, fitted corset silhouette with a romantic sweetheart neckline.

Exquisite sheer ivory lace extending across the shoulders and arms.

Delicate off-shoulder illusion neckline.

Intricate floral embroidery and ornate lace appliqués.

Hundreds of tiny pearls, translucent crystals, and hand-sewn beads.

Elaborate symmetrical pearl chains draped across the bust.

A central teardrop-shaped pearl ornament.

Fine silver-thread embroidery and delicate floral motifs.

Sleeves: Long, fitted, semi-transparent illusion lace sleeves with embroidered floral patterns, pearl detailing, and scalloped lace cuffs extending elegantly over the hands.

Skirt: Slim, fitted bridal silhouette flowing into a graceful floor-length train, embellished with fine lace and subtle embroidered patterns.

Veil: An enormous cathedral-length sheer ivory tulle veil attached to the back of her blonde updo, extending several meters behind her. The veil has delicate embroidered lace edging and responds naturally to gentle wind, floating and billowing in the sunlight.

The gown must remain identical in every shot. No changes in neckline, embroidery, sleeve design, pearl placement, or veil length.

ENVIRONMENT

A magnificent historic European stone castle with Gothic Revival architecture, imposing towers, ornate windows, crenellated rooftops, grand terraces, and weathered limestone façades.

The castle is surrounded by:

Beautifully maintained formal English gardens.

Perfectly sculpted geometric hedges.

Tall conical topiary trees.

White blooming roses.

Ancient stone balustrades.

Ornamental stone urns and sculptures.

A large reflective ornamental pool.

Symmetrical gravel pathways.

Lighting: Warm late-afternoon golden-hour sunlight coming from behind and beside the bride, creating beautiful rim lighting around her blonde hair, translucent lace sleeves, and enormous veil.

Soft shadows, natural atmospheric haze, subtle sun flares, warm highlights, realistic reflections, and gentle cinematic contrast.

SHOT-BY-SHOT CINEMATIC SEQUENCE

00:00–00:01.2 — ANCIENT GARDEN DETAIL

Begin with an extreme cinematic close-up of an aged limestone ornamental urn featuring a beautifully sculpted classical human face and decorative carved details.

Warm sunlight illuminates the weathered stone surface while the dark-green garden foliage behind it remains beautifully blurred.

Camera slowly slides sideways with shallow depth of field.

00:01.2–00:02.5 — THE BRIDE'S REVEAL

Cut to a medium portrait shot of the blonde bride standing gracefully beside tall sculpted hedges.

Her body is turned slightly sideways while her face turns toward the camera.

The sunlight illuminates the edges of her blonde hair, delicate veil, and lace sleeves.

She maintains a calm, regal expression.

Camera performs a slow, elegant dolly-in.

00:02.5–00:03.5 — COUTURE MACRO DETAIL

Extreme macro close-up of the wedding gown's exquisite corset bodice.

Reveal the intricate pearl chains, symmetrical embroidery, delicate lace textures, tiny crystals, and central teardrop pearl ornament.

The camera gently glides across the fabric, capturing individual threads, pearls, and realistic reflections.

00:03.5–00:05.0 — THE CASTLE REFLECTION

Spectacular ultra-wide establishing shot.

The bride stands elegantly beside the large reflective pool, with the enormous historic castle filling the background.

Her cathedral-length veil stretches dramatically behind her, lifted by a gentle breeze.

The water reflects the castle architecture and soft golden sky.

Camera slowly tracks sideways, emphasizing the grand scale of the location and the flowing bridal silhouette.

00:05.0–00:06.5 — THE FLOWING VEIL

Medium rear three-quarter shot of the bride standing on the stone terrace.

The castle appears softly illuminated behind her.

Her translucent veil catches the sunlight and billows elegantly through the air.

She slowly turns her head over her shoulder, revealing her graceful profile.

Camera gently orbits around her.

00:06.5–00:08.0 — ETHEREAL BEAUTY PORTRAIT

Extreme close-up of the bride's face, partially softened by the translucent veil.

Her pale-blue eyes look directly into the camera.

Natural blonde strands frame her face, while warm sunlight filters through the delicate tulle.

Capture realistic skin pores, natural eyelashes, subtle lip texture, and delicate facial movements.

The camera moves closer with exceptionally shallow depth of field.

00:08.0–00:09.5 — THE ROSE GARDEN

Medium full-body fashion shot.

The bride stands among blooming white roses and sculpted garden hedges.

Her fitted embroidered gown and long veil remain perfectly visible.

She subtly shifts her posture and turns her head toward the camera.

A light breeze moves the veil while the flowers sway naturally.

00:09.5–00:10.5 — LACE AND PEARL DETAIL

Extreme close-up of the bride's elegant hand resting gently on a weathered stone balustrade.

Focus on the transparent lace sleeve, fine floral embroidery, tiny pearls, and delicate scalloped cuff.

Her fingers relax naturally against the stone.

The camera performs a slow macro tracking movement.

00:10.5–00:12.0 — THE ROYAL GARDEN WALK

Wide symmetrical rear shot of the bride standing along a beautiful gravel pathway lined with perfectly shaped conical hedges.

Her enormous cathedral-length veil and embroidered train extend elegantly across the ground.

She slowly begins walking away from the camera.

The camera remains centered, creating a striking composition emphasizing the symmetry of the garden and the length of the veil.

00:12.0–00:13.5 — THE FINAL BEAUTY CLOSE-UP

Intimate frontal close-up of the bride's face.

Her striking blue eyes, natural rosy cheeks, softly parted lips, and delicate blonde hair strands are sharply detailed.

Warm golden sunlight softly illuminates one side of her face.

She looks directly into the lens with a subtle, confident expression.

Camera gently pushes closer.

00:13.5–00:15.0 — THE GRAND FINALE

End with a breathtaking, perfectly composed wide frontal shot of the bride standing in front of the magnificent European castle.

The bride is centered in the frame beside the reflective pool.

Her magnificent cathedral-length veil stretches several meters sideways and backward, gracefully floating in the golden-hour breeze.

The castle towers rise dramatically behind her, creating an extraordinary royal bridal portrait.

Camera performs an extremely subtle cinematic push-in as the veil continues to flutter.

End on a majestic, timeless fashion-editorial composition.

CINEMATOGRAPHY AND CAMERA SETTINGS

Camera: ARRI Alexa 35, full-frame cinematic lens simulation.

Lenses: 85mm portrait lens for facial close-ups, 100mm macro for embroidery, 35mm for medium fashion shots, and 24mm for castle establishing shots.

Movement: Slow controlled dolly-in, smooth lateral tracking, subtle orbiting movements, elegant locked-off symmetrical compositions.

Depth of field: Shallow for portraits and macro shots, deeper for architectural wide shots.

Color grading: Soft ivory whites, warm champagne highlights, natural golden skin tones, muted botanical greens, pale limestone colors, and subtle cinematic film grain.

Motion: Natural human movements, realistic fabric physics, physically accurate veil movement, gentle breeze, no artificial slow-motion distortions.

Editing: Elegant cinematic cuts, carefully timed fashion-film pacing, no aggressive transitions.

AUDIO DIRECTION

A luxurious, romantic instrumental soundtrack featuring delicate piano, soft orchestral strings, and gentle cinematic swells.

Subtle ambient sounds of the garden breeze, distant birds, and delicate fabric movement.

No dialogue, no voiceover.

NEGATIVE PROMPT

Cartoon, anime, illustration, artificial CGI, video-game graphics, plastic skin, porcelain face, excessive beauty filters, unnatural facial proportions, inconsistent character identity, changing gown design, missing pearl embellishments, distorted lace patterns, changing veil length, unnatural fabric physics, stiff body movements, deformed hands, extra fingers, distorted architecture, warped castle towers, excessive lens flare, overexposed white dress, unrealistic wind, flickering embroidery, inconsistent lighting, low-resolution textures, excessive camera shake, artificial background blur, subtitles, text overlays, logos, watermarks.

FINAL CREATIVE DIRECTION: Every frame should look like an expensive international bridal couture campaign photographed at a historic European castle. Prioritize extraordinary facial realism, intricate wedding-gown craftsmanship, beautiful golden-hour light, grand architectural compositions, and breathtaking cathedral-veil movement.

Create a 30-second ultra-photorealistic Korean zombie survival thriller, cinematic live-action style.

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY: Young adult Korean woman, identical face, hairstyle, outfit, and body proportions to the reference image throughout. Expression evolves from terrified to desperate, determined, then shaken relief.

ZOMBIES: Aggressive, realistic human-like zombies with pale dirty skin, sunken eyes, damaged faces, messy hair, and torn everyday clothing. Practical horror makeup, no excessive gore.

LOCATION: One consistent dim Korean apartment tower: concrete stairwell, narrow numbered-door corridor, flickering greenish fluorescent lights, metal elevator with glowing floor indicator, CLOSE DOOR button, and pulsing red emergency light.

30-SECOND SEQUENCE (10 SHOTS):

1. 0–3s: Close-up, woman sprints down stairs as zombie hands reach from above.
2. 3–6s: She bursts into corridor, shoves an attacking zombie into the wall.
3. 6–9s: Rear tracking shot as she races toward the elevator, zombies emerging behind her.
4. 9–12s: She repeatedly presses elevator call button; horde approaches.
5. 12–15s: Doors open; she dives inside as zombies charge.
6. 15–18s: Extreme close-up, repeatedly jams CLOSE DOOR button as doors begin shutting.
7. 18–21s: Zombie arms force through the gap; she kicks them away.
8. 21–24s: Doors slam shut; she trembles as zombies pound outside.
9. 24–27s: Elevator descends; she collapses against the wall, gasping.
10. 27–30s: Lobby doors open, revealing motionless shadowy figures. One slowly turns its head. Extreme close-up of her terrified eyes. CUT TO BLACK.

CINEMATOGRAPHY: Handheld chase tracking, dynamic wide shots, extreme close-ups, low-angle elevator struggle, realistic movement, natural motion blur, cinematic green-gray lighting, practical VFX, consistent spatial continuity.

AUDIO: Heavy breathing, rapid footsteps, zombie snarls, fluorescent buzz, elevator chime, metallic scraping, pounding doors, elevator hum, rising horror drone. No narration.

NEGATIVE: No location changes, rooftop, outdoor scenes, phones, weapons, superhero powers, fantasy effects, extra limbs, duplicated heroine, identity or outfit changes, cartoon/anime, excessive gore, subtitles, random text, or watermark.

OUTPUT: One coherent, suspenseful, photorealistic 30-second Korean zombie-thriller sequence with seamless character and environment consistency.

Style: High-quality 3D animated family comedy, adorable baby character, Pixar-inspired cinematic animation, ultra-detailed textures, expressive facial animations, warm lighting, realistic movement, and professional cinematic storytelling.

Character: An adorable chubby baby girl with big sparkling brown eyes, rosy cheeks, short dark brown hair, wearing a cute green knitted frog hat with big frog eyes and a white baby romper featuring a small green frog design.

Visual Quality: Ultra-detailed 3D animation, realistic knitted fabric, soft baby skin, expressive eyes, natural body movements, cinematic depth of field, warm golden-hour lighting, smooth camera transitions, professional animation, 4K quality, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio.

ENGINE DIRECTIVE: Create exactly 30 seconds of photorealistic Hollywood-style zombie action, 16:9 widescreen, 60fps where supported. Use @image1 for protagonist identity, @image2 for zombie design, and @image3 for the ruined city environment.

TIMELINE:

00–03s: Wide cinematic reveal of the ruined city. The protagonist notices two zombies approaching from opposite sides and draws his machete.

03–06s: Zombie A charges. The protagonist dodges its grab and counters with a fast, controlled machete strike. Zombie A collapses.

24–27s: The protagonist stands between both defeated zombies, breathing heavily while holding the machete.

MAIN CHARACTER — STRICT IDENTITY LOCK
A beautiful 22-year-old Korean schoolgirl with long golden-blonde hair, wearing a dark navy-blue school blazer, a white button-up shirt, a red striped tie, a black-and-red plaid mini skirt, white socks, and black school shoes.
Her face is filled with terror. Her breathing is rapid, her eyes are wide with fear, and she is desperately running for her life.
Her golden-blonde hair flies wildly behind her as she sprints. Her blazer, tie, and skirt react naturally to her movements and the wind.
STRICT IDENTITY CONSISTENCY: Maintain exactly the same face, hairstyle, outfit, body proportions, and facial features throughout the entire sequence.

SCENE 01 — 0:00–0:05 | HIGHWAY PANIC

Camera: Low-angle cinematic side-tracking shot, transitioning into a fast handheld chase.

A massive highway is completely blocked by hundreds of abandoned vehicles. The sky is covered with thick gray clouds, and the asphalt is wet from recent rainfall.

The Korean schoolgirl sprints desperately between stationary cars, trying to escape.

Suddenly, an enormous, aggressive wild boar bursts out from between two vehicles.

The creature has a massive muscular body, muddy dark-brown fur, visible scratches, enormous curved tusks, and terrifying natural animal movements.
It violently crashes into a black sedan, smashing its bumper and shattering the windows.

Glass fragments scatter across the wet highway.

The girl hears the impact and turns her head in terror.

The camera rapidly whip-pans from the destroyed vehicle back to her frightened face.

SCENE 02 — 0:05–0:10 | FACE TO FACE WITH DEATH

Camera: Front-facing tracking shot moving backward at the girl's running speed.

The girl sprints between two parked SUVs.

Suddenly, the gigantic wild boar charges directly toward her from behind.

Its powerful hooves slam against the wet asphalt, sending water splashing in every direction.

The creature runs with realistic animal biomechanics, its massive shoulders moving violently with every stride.

The girl looks backward for a split second.
Her eyes widen in absolute terror.

She screams and accelerates, desperately trying to outrun the enormous animal.

The camera remains extremely close to her face while the wild boar rapidly closes the distance behind her.

SCENE 03 — 0:10–0:15 | THE NEAR-FATAL ATTACK

Camera: Aggressive over-the-shoulder tracking shot, followed by a sudden ground-level perspective.

The wild boar launches a terrifying forward charge.

Its enormous tusks narrowly miss the girl's body, tearing the fabric of her blazer as it passes.

The sudden movement causes her to lose her balance.

She stumbles forward and crashes onto the wet asphalt.

Her hands strike the road first, absorbing the impact.

Her golden-blonde hair falls across her face, and her school uniform reacts naturally to the fall.
The camera rapidly drops to ground level, capturing the impact with intense realism.

In the background, several additional wild boars emerge from between the abandoned vehicles.

Car alarms echo across the highway.

SCENE 04 — 0:15–0:21 | DESPERATE SURVIVAL

Camera: Low-angle handheld close-up transitioning into a fast backward-tracking shot.

The girl struggles to get up from the slippery road.

Her palms slide across the wet asphalt.

She pushes herself onto one knee and looks backward.

Three enormous wild boars are charging directly toward her at full speed.

Their heavy footsteps shake the ground.

Water splashes beneath their hooves.

The girl's expression changes from fear to pure survival instinct.
She forces herself upright and immediately begins sprinting again.

The camera races backward in front of her, capturing her terrified expression while the charging animals remain visible behind her.

Abandoned vehicles, shattered glass, and flashing hazard lights create an intense disaster-movie atmosphere.

SCENE 05 — 0:21–0:26 | THE TRUCK ESCAPE

Camera: Fast side-tracking shot transitioning into an extremely low ground-level perspective.

The girl notices a large black cargo truck stopped across the highway.

The wild boars are rapidly approaching from behind.

With no other escape route, she lowers her body and performs a desperate sliding maneuver beneath the stationary truck.

Her hands and knees slide across the wet asphalt.

The camera follows her underneath the vehicle, remaining only inches above the road.

She pulls herself deeper beneath the truck, keeping her body as low as possible.

An enormous wild boar charges past the outside of the truck.

Its massive hooves thunder dangerously close to the camera.
The girl freezes, terrified of being discovered.

SCENE 06 — 0:26–0:30 | FINAL SUSPENSE

Camera: Extreme close-up beneath the truck, slowly pushing toward the girl's face.

The girl lies motionless beneath the stationary cargo truck.

Her golden-blonde hair is scattered across her frightened face.

Her breathing is rapid and uneven.

She desperately tries to remain silent.

Suddenly, a gigantic wild boar stops directly outside the truck.

Its heavy breathing becomes clearly audible.

The creature begins sniffing the ground.

The girl slowly turns her head toward the sound.

A massive animal shadow moves across her face.
The camera pushes into an extreme close-up of her terrified eyes.

FINAL SHOT: The wild boar lowers its enormous head toward the opening beneath the truck.

Its curved tusks become visible in the darkness.

The girl holds her breath.

SUDDEN CUT TO BLACK.

Ultra-realistic live-action Korean disaster thriller, Hollywood-level visual effects, physically accurate wild boar anatomy, natural animal running mechanics, realistic human movement, aggressive handheld cinematography, fast tracking shots, intense low-angle perspectives, dynamic camera movement, cinematic motion blur, wet asphalt reflections, overcast daylight, realistic vehicle destruction, physically accurate glass fragmentation, detailed fur simulation, natural hair movement, realistic fabric physics, atmospheric depth, dramatic shadows, high-contrast cinematic color grading, photorealistic skin textures, seamless scene continuity, 4K resolution, 60 FPS.

Use brief 120 FPS slow-motion inserts only for the near-miss attack, the girl's fall, and the slide beneath the truck. All other action must play at natural real-time speed.

Powerful cinematic orchestral percussion, aggressive wild boar growls, heavy hooves striking wet asphalt, car alarms, shattering glass, distant human screams, splashing water, rapid footsteps, terrified breathing, deep cinematic bass impacts, and rising suspense music.

The music gradually intensifies throughout the chase, then becomes almost completely silent during the final moments beneath the truck.

End with a sudden deep bass impact followed by complete silence.

STRICT NEGATIVE PROMPT

No cartoon physics, no unrealistic animal anatomy, no floating bodies, no exaggerated jumping, no unnatural running, no teleportation, no duplicated characters, no extra limbs, no distorted hands, no facial identity changes, no hairstyle changes, no inconsistent clothing, no unrealistic body movements, no artificial-looking CGI, no sudden environment changes, no camera clipping, no excessive gore, no random scene transitions.

FINAL GENERATION RULE: Maintain maximum photorealism, continuous character identity, accurate environmental physics, realistic animal behavior, intense cinematic pacing, and seamless visual continuity throughout the entire 30-second sequence.

Create an ultra-photorealistic, emotionally explosive, high-budget Korean supernatural revenge action scene inside a modern South Korean high school classroom.

The scene must feature aggressive bullying, a shocking physical slap, intense emotional confrontation, terrifying supernatural awakening, spectacular telekinetic destruction, and a powerful revenge climax.

The atmosphere should resemble a premium live-action Korean supernatural thriller, combining realistic human performances, brutal emotional tension, sophisticated cinematography, and physically convincing supernatural action.

DURATION: Exactly 30 seconds.

FORMAT: 16:9 widescreen, 4K cinematic quality, 24fps.

CAMERA STYLE: Dynamic handheld cinematography, fast whip pans, dramatic push-ins, intense facial close-ups, low-angle hero shots, realistic camera shake during impacts, and occasional brief slow-motion accents.

LIGHTING: Bright natural afternoon sunlight entering through large classroom windows, mixed with realistic overhead classroom lighting.

ENVIRONMENT: Authentic Korean high school classroom containing wooden desks, metal-framed chairs, notebooks, backpacks, textbooks, pencils, a large green chalkboard, wall clocks, classroom decorations, and approximately 20 Korean students.

All characters are 18-year-old final-year students.

MAIN HEROINE — THE GIRL WITH SECRET POWERS @image (12) 

She secretly possesses extraordinarily powerful telekinetic abilities.

Her abilities include controlling hundreds of objects simultaneously, generating invisible shockwaves, lifting heavy furniture, stopping moving objects, and restraining people without touching them.

Whenever she activates her powers, her irises develop a subtle electric-pink glow.

The glow must remain concentrated inside her irises.

No glowing hands, visible magical energy, pink lightning, or laser beams.

Her power manifests entirely through invisible force and environmental destruction.

MAIN ANTAGONIST — THE CLASSROOM QUEEN @Image 

An arrogant 18-year-old Korean female student with long dark-brown hair, fashionable makeup, and a cruel, intimidating personality.

She wears a traditional navy-and-white Korean school uniform with a short pleated skirt.

She is accompanied by two female friends who encourage her bullying.

Her personality changes dramatically from arrogant confidence to overwhelming terror after witnessing the heroine's abilities.

SHOT 1 — THE NOTEBOOK HUMILIATION

0–4 SECONDS

Wide cinematic shot of a busy Korean classroom during the afternoon.

Students are chatting and laughing.
The heroine {@image (12) stands confidently beside her classroom desk, adjusting her schoolbag over her shoulder as she prepares to leave. Suddenly, an arrogant female @Image bully storms toward her, aggressively grabs her schoolbag, and throws it onto the floor. The heroine turns sharply, staring at the bully with a cold, fearless expression. The bully steps closer, deliberately bumps her shoulder, and mocks her in front of the entire classroom. Several students begin laughing while others watch nervously. The heroine refuses to back down, creating an intense face-to-face confrontation.

BULLY: "Look at this pathetic little girl!"

She @Image picks up one notebook and violently tears several pages from the notebook.

Paper fragments scatter across the desk.

Her two friends laugh loudly.

The heroine stands up and reaches toward her notebook.

HEROINE: "Give it back."

The bully smirks.

SHOT 2 — THE HARD SLAP

4–8 SECONDS

Medium close-up showing both girls standing face-to-face.

The bully aggressively shoves the heroine backward against her desk.

The heroine steadies herself.

She looks directly at the bully.

HEROINE: "Don't touch me again."

The bully's expression turns furious.

Suddenly, she swings her right hand and delivers ONE HARD, SHARP, OPEN-PALM SLAP across the heroine's @image (12) left cheek.

IMPORTANT: Show the complete slap in one continuous medium shot.

The bully's palm makes visible contact with the heroine's cheek.

The heroine's head snaps sideways from the impact.

Her hair @image (12) whips dramatically across her face.

A loud, realistic slap echoes throughout the classroom.

The heroine stumbles one step sideways and catches herself against a desk.

No blood or visible injury.

Several students gasp.

Others laugh nervously.

The bully @Image leans forward with a cruel smile.

BULLY: "Know your place."

The heroine remains silent.

SHOT 3 — THE TERRIFYING AWAKENING

8–12 SECONDS

Extreme cinematic close-up of the heroine's face.

Her cheek is slightly red from the slap.

She slowly turns her head toward the bully.

Her expression changes from shock to terrifying emotional stillness.

Her jaw tightens.

Her breathing becomes controlled.

A single tear forms in her eye.

Suddenly, her irises begin glowing a subtle electric pink.

The classroom clock stops ticking.

A nearby pencil begins vibrating.

The torn notebook pages freeze in midair.

A falling eraser stops inches above the floor.

The entire classroom becomes unnaturally quiet.

The bully notices the floating paper.

Her smile disappears.

BULLY: "What... are you?"

The heroine whispers:

HEROINE: "Your worst mistake."

SHOT 4 — THE FIRST TELEKINETIC EXPLOSION

12–16 SECONDS

The bully angrily attempts to slap the heroine a second time.

She raises her right hand.

Before the slap lands, her arm suddenly bend in midair.

An invisible telekinetic force prevents her from moving.

Her eyes widen in panic.

The heroine slowly raises two fingers.

BOOM.

A massive invisible telekinetic shockwave erupts.

The bully is thrown backward across the classroom and lands on a pile of overturned chairs.

Several empty desks slide violently across the floor.

Books launch upward.

Loose papers spiral through the air.

A metal chair flips over.

Students scream and duck behind their desks.

The heroine remains completely stationary.

Her electric-pink eyes glow with supernatural intensity.

Her hair moves gently in the displaced air.

SHOT 5 — THE CLASSROOM BECOMES A NIGHTMARE

16–21 SECONDS

Fast-paced supernatural action sequence.

The bully struggles to stand.

One of her friends grabs a textbook and throws it toward the heroine.

The heroine does not move.

The flying textbook suddenly freezes inches from her face.

She slowly turns her eyes toward the book.

It violently reverses direction and slams into an empty classroom cupboard.

The cupboard doors burst open.

Dozens of textbooks launch into the air.

Three empty student desks rise several feet above the floor.

Metal chairs rotate violently.

Pencils and notebooks spiral around the heroine.

The camera performs a fast 180-degree orbit around her.

Her hair blows backward.

Her expression remains cold and fearless.

The bully crawls backward in terror.

BULLY: "Stop! Please!"

The heroine slowly walks toward her.

SHOT 6 — ABSOLUTE SUPERNATURAL DOMINANCE

21–25 SECONDS

Low-angle cinematic tracking shot.

The heroine approaches the terrified bully.

Behind her, dozens of chairs, books, pencils, and desks remain suspended in midair.

The bully attempts to escape.

The heroine slowly closes her fingers.

The bully suddenly freezes in place.

An invisible force lifts her several inches above the classroom floor.

Her feet dangle helplessly.

She struggles to move.

The heroine stops directly in front of her.

Her electric-pink eyes narrow. @image (12) slaps bully @Image on the face three times so hard on her left cheek and right cheek with her right hand.

HEROINE: "You should've kept your hands to yourself."

The heroine slowly lowers her hand.

The bully drops safely into an empty chair.

She trembles in fear.

SHOT 7 — THE FINAL TELEKINETIC DESTRUCTION

25–28 SECONDS

Extreme close-up of the heroine's glowing pink eyes.

The classroom becomes completely silent.

Hundreds of torn notebook pages remain suspended throughout the room.

Heavy desks and chairs hover behind her.

The heroine slowly closes her fist.

An enormous invisible shockwave explodes outward.

Every suspended desk, chair, book, and pencil crashes simultaneously onto unoccupied areas of the classroom.

A violent metallic impact echoes throughout the building.

The chalkboard shakes.

Classroom windows rattle.

Dust rises from the floor.

The bully screams and shields her face.

No objects strike the students.

The heroine stands perfectly still in the center of the destruction.

SHOT 8 — THE FINAL WARNING

A white Maserati emerges slowly from a luxurious underground parking entrance at midnight. The camera begins with an extreme low-angle close-up of its headlights illuminating the wet asphalt. The front wheels turn slightly as the car smoothly enters the empty boulevard.

Cut to a cinematic side-tracking shot revealing the woman behind the steering wheel, her face illuminated by passing golden city lights. Her sleek high ponytail is visible through the window. The engine produces a deep, powerful sound as the car accelerates into the night.

SCENE 2 — THE DRIVER | CINEMATIC CLOSE-UP

The camera smoothly approaches the driver’s side window. A close-up captures her hands confidently holding the steering wheel, showcasing her elegant rings and nails.
The camera slowly moves toward her face. She briefly glances at the illuminated city skyline before returning her gaze to the road. Passing streetlights create beautiful moving highlights across her face. Her high ponytail moves subtly with the car’s motion. Her expression remains calm, mysterious, and effortlessly confident.

SCENE 3 — THE LUXURY ARRIVAL | FASHION REVEAL

The Maserati arrives at an exclusive rooftop parking area overlooking a breathtaking nighttime city skyline. The car comes to a smooth stop, and the driver’s door opens.

She steps out gracefully, adjusts the sleeve of her black leather jacket, and picks up her elegant black handbag. The camera captures her complete outfit in a cinematic three-quarter shot, with the white supercar and glowing skyline behind her.
A gentle breeze moves her high ponytail as she looks toward the city with a quiet, confident expression.

SCENE 4 — THE SIGNATURE DETAILS | FASHION & LUXURY

A cinematic sequence of elegant close-up shots. Her hand gently closes the car door, followed by a detailed shot of her gold rings, manicured nails, and structured black handbag.

The camera captures the texture of her leather jacket, tailored trousers, and elegant boots stepping onto the glossy rooftop floor.

A smooth rack focus transitions from her accessories toward her face as she turns slightly toward the camera. Every movement feels natural, effortless, and sophisticated.
SCENE 5 — THE FINAL REVEAL | ICONIC HERO SHOT

She walks slowly toward the front of the white Maserati and stops beside its front fender. She gently rests one hand on the car while holding her handbag in the other.

The camera begins with a dramatic low-angle view of the vehicle before slowly rising to reveal her complete silhouette and face.

She turns her head toward the camera with a subtle, confident expression. The illuminated city skyline glows behind her as golden reflections sweep across the white bodywork.

The final frame captures her, the Maserati, and the luxurious nighttime skyline in one perfectly composed cinematic hero shot.

Create a 30-second ultra-realistic Korean cinematic mystery thriller with the visual quality of a premium Korean feature film.

CHARACTER:
A 28-year-old Korean businessman with short black hair, wearing a black formal suit, white shirt, and black tie. Maintain identical facial features, clothing, and appearance throughout every scene.

SCENE 1 (0–7 SECONDS):
Late at night in Seoul, a businessman enters a luxurious modern apartment elevator. He presses floor 18. The elevator doors slowly close. He checks his wristwatch. The elevator begins moving upward.

SCENE 2 (7–14 SECONDS):
Suddenly, the elevator lights flicker. The floor display changes from 12 to 11, then displays an unfamiliar number: 0. The elevator stops. The doors slowly open, revealing a long, completely empty underground corridor with cold fluorescent lighting.

SCENE 3 (14–22 SECONDS):
The businessman looks confused and steps slightly forward. At the far end of the corridor, he notices a little Korean girl wearing a red coat. She is standing completely still, facing away from him. He calls out, but she does not respond. Suddenly, the elevator doors begin closing behind him.

SCENE 4 (22–30 SECONDS):
He rushes back into the elevator and presses the emergency button. The doors close. He looks into the elevator mirror and sees the little girl standing directly behind him. He turns around immediately. Nobody is there.

The elevator display changes to FLOOR 18.

FINAL SHOT:
As the doors open, the businessman sees himself standing outside the elevator, wearing the exact same suit, staring directly at him with a terrifying smile.

CUT TO BLACK.

CINEMATOGRAPHY:
Premium Korean thriller cinematography, realistic human expressions, atmospheric shadows, slow camera pushes, cinematic close-ups, symmetrical framing, natural skin textures, realistic elevator reflections, professional color grading, and subtle film grain.

SOUND DESIGN:
Elevator mechanical hum, soft electrical buzzing, footsteps echoing through the corridor, subtle heartbeat sound, suspenseful cinematic music, and sudden silence during the final reveal.

STRICT REQUIREMENTS:
Photorealistic live-action only. No animation, no cartoon style, no artificial-looking characters, no inconsistent faces, no random wardrobe changes, no unnecessary dialogue, no watermarks. Preserve character continuity and realistic physical movement throughout the entire 30-second film.

15-second cinematic 16:9 ultra-realistic live-action Kyoto autumn dance film. Natural daylight only.

TWO JAPANESE FEMALE DANCERS ONLY.

IDENTITY LOCK:
Preserve @image1 exact face, facial structure, eyes, nose, lips, eyebrows, beauty mark, hairstyle and identity.
Preserve @image2 exact face, facial structure, eyes, nose, lips, eyebrows, hairstyle and identity.
Keep their exact reference outfits and accessories in every scene. Natural human proportions. Never alter either face.

MUSIC (drives all the action):
Modern wafuu hip-hop, a blend of traditional Japanese instruments and trap-pop, 96 BPM (one beat every 0.625s). Breathy shakuhachi flute and plucked koto, deep taiko drum hits, crisp finger snaps, rolling 808 sub-bass, a bold shamisen riff, soft female "hey-ho" vocal chant accents. Structure: cold open with flute and wind only (0–2.5s), the beat enters on a heavy taiko hit at 2.5s, groove builds (2.5–8s), full drop with 808 and shamisen riff (8–11.5s), sudden half-time breakdown (11.5–13.1s), beat snaps back into a final taiko hit (14.4s) and silence. Every movement lands exactly on the beat and the choreography energy follows the music.

DANCE STYLE:
Wafuu hip-hop: sharp popping and locking hits on taiko beats, flowing arm waves like wind through leaves, heel-toe shuffles, chest and shoulder isolations, playful smirks and teasing eye contact. Cool, graceful and controlled, never exaggerated. Alternate between canon (one dancer follows the other a beat later), mirror and unison moments.

SCENE 1 (0–3.75s): Misty bamboo grove, early morning
Tall green bamboo, soft god-rays through morning mist, a stone path, fallen leaves on the ground.
0.0–2.5s: A slow crane shot descends through the bamboo to the dancers standing back to back, eyes closed, completely still. Flute plays, wind moves hair and fabric.
2.5s: Taiko hit. Eyes snap open, both heads whip toward the camera.
2.5–3.75s: Right arm slices forward with a shoulder hit, then they step apart in a sharp pop-lock.
TRANSITION: A bamboo stalk sweeps across the frame in the foreground and wipes to the next scene. Natural, no CGI effects.

SCENE 2 (3.75–8.0s): Stone steps under a tunnel of vermilion torii gates, dappled sunlight
Dancers descend the steps toward the camera in canon: @image1 starts, @image2 follows one beat later.
Step-lock on every stair, chest pops, wind-like arm waves passing from one dancer to the other, a foot slide, then a two-stair jump-step landing exactly on the beat with dry leaves kicking up around their feet. Gate pillars passing overhead create natural light flicker on their faces.
Camera: low-angle tracking backward down the steps, smooth and physically realistic.
TRANSITION: Hard cut on the beat to a wooden lane.

SCENE 3 (8.0–11.5s): Old Kyoto wooden lane, daytime, dark timber lattice facades and indigo noren curtains swaying in the breeze
Full drop with the shamisen riff.
Fast heel-toe shuffle, locking points, shoulder isolations, mirrored side slides, then the dancers swap places by passing through the noren curtains. One disappears behind the cloth and the other emerges from the opposite side on the next beat. On the taiko hit each snaps open a small folding paper fan with a sharp flick, then they fan out into a diagonal formation.
Camera: waist-height steadicam lateral track, a gentle orbit, shallow depth of field.

SCENE 4 (11.5–15.0s): Riverside ginkgo path at golden hour, golden leaves falling, backlit sun glow
11.5–13.1s: Half-time breakdown. Fluid slow arm waves, a long hair flip and a jacket flare, a twirl with the skirt swirling, golden leaves spinning around them. They share a playful glance and a smirk.
13.1–14.4s: The beat snaps back with a fast synchronized combo: arm slice, jump, spin, shoulder hit.
14.4–15.0s: A final kabuki-inspired mie freeze pose on the last taiko hit: one arm extended, chin lifted, eyes locked on the camera, ginkgo leaves hanging in the air. Slow push-in, then a brief cinematic hold in silence.

CAMERA:
Scene 1 crane descent, Scene 2 low-angle backward tracking, Scene 3 steadicam lateral track with orbit, Scene 4 slow push-in. Smooth and physically realistic. No excessive shaking, no random zoom. Both dancers always clearly visible. Natural depth of field, tiny lens parallax, realistic motion blur only on fast moves.

PERFORMANCE:
Clean, fast choreography with natural weight transfer, realistic foot contact, natural knee and hip articulation, believable arm momentum. Hair, ponytail, skirt, jackets and trousers react naturally to movement.

LIGHTING & COLOR:
Scene 1 cool misty green morning light. Scene 2 warm dappled sunlight through vermilion gates. Scene 3 soft neutral daylight with indigo and timber tones. Scene 4 warm golden-hour backlight with amber highlights. Cinematic film color grading, rich autumn palette of green, vermilion, indigo and gold, clean natural skin tones, soft filmic dynamic range, premium Japanese fashion-film look.

REALISM:
Ultra-realistic live-action humans, visible skin texture and pores, individual hair strands, realistic eye reflections, physically accurate fabric, leaves and shadows.

STRICT NEGATIVE:
No neon lights, no neon colors, no LED glow, no night scenes, no plastic skin, no CGI, no anime, no 3D render, no beauty filter, no stiff or robotic movement, no facial morphing, no face replacement, no identity change, no hairstyle or outfit change, no glowing eyes, no extra fingers or limbs, no duplicated dancers, no body distortion, no text, subtitles or watermarks, no teleportation.

📌 PROMPT 3 (Animation prompt):

SCENE 1 (0 to 30s)
Late-1980s Manhattan. A striking, self-possessed woman goes about her day on a busy street. A man films her discreetly FROM THE OPPOSITE PAVEMENT. She orders coffee, collects it after an editorial time jump, stops for a spontaneous conversation, then continues to her car. She finally catches the observer looking and disappears into the vehicle.

SHOT STRUCTURE:
8 shots, 30 seconds total, 16:9, exactly as listed. Brisk real-time action with short editorial jumps. The coffee-order and collection shots explicitly show different moments. One observer’s footage throughout.

REFS:
@Image1 = WOMAN. Controls her exact face, blonde hairstyle, proportions, ivory suit, striped burgundy tie, jewellery and black handbag only. Use the large portrait for identity and the full-length view for clothing.
@Image2 = CAR. Controls the black car’s exact design, proportions, chrome, wheels and cream interior only.
Create fresh street compositions. Reference-sheet layouts and studio backgrounds stay outside the video.

GLOBAL STYLE NOTES:
lighting_philosophy: Autumn afternoon sunlight reaches the street diagonally, with cool open shade beneath awnings. Warm highlights move naturally across her hair and ivory tailoring as she walks. Preserve texture in white clothes and detail in the black car.

color_grade: Visibly analog late-1980s 35mm film: persistent organic grain, creamy highlights, tobacco-brown stone, muted yellow taxis, warm skin and gently cool shadows. Restrained saturation, soft highlight bloom, rounded contrast and slightly soft optical detail. Carry the references’ photographic texture through every shot, including camera shake and the final pavement view.

setting: A genuinely busy Manhattan shopping block in 1989. Pedestrians pass in both directions, customers occupy café tables, someone browses newspapers, delivery workers move cartons, yellow taxis and period sedans pass between the observer and the woman. Activity continues independently around her. Stone façades, brass hotel doors, café awnings, a newspaper stand and street steam establish the period.

ambience: Street sound recorded from the observer’s side: passing engines, horns, footsteps, layered distant voices and occasional wind against the microphone. Her speech remains spatially distant beneath the traffic, with natural mouth synchronization. Running briefly brings the operator’s footfalls and handling noise forward. No narration, music or subtitles.

characters:
  character_1: WOMAN, exactly @Image1. Upright, statuesque, exceptionally beautiful, comfortable taking up space. She walks with purpose and chooses where to give her attention. Her expressions respond to actual events: irritation at traffic, courtesy at the café, spontaneous warmth toward a friend, then a cool assessment of the observer. Her handbag stays on her left forearm. Her right hand handles payment, coffee and keys in sequence. Natural conversational voice, relaxed and brighter when greeting her friend.
  character_2: OPERATOR, an adult man behind the camera. He stays on the opposite pavement, trying to retain a clear line of sight without drawing attention. Only his own charcoal trouser legs and black leather shoes become visible at the end.
  character_3: CAFÉ ATTENDANT, behind an outward-facing service window, serving several customers.
  character_4: ACQUAINTANCE, a man in a dark wool coat walking toward the woman on her pavement. He recognizes her unexpectedly, stops and genuinely engages with her. A lower conversational voice, an easy familiar delivery.

gaze_safety: Her gaze belongs to the people and objects she encounters. She looks directly into the filming lens only once, immediately before entering the car. That look is brief and unsmiling.

camera_character: The camera is physically held by ONE standing man at his eye level, approximately 1.75 metres. Maintain 12–18 metres of actual separation from the woman, with the roadway between them. Tighter framing comes from an optical zoom, never from approaching her. Small uneven hand tremors persist even when he stands still; walking introduces irregular sway. Pans sometimes start late, briefly overshoot and settle. People, poles and vehicles interrupt the view. Focus briefly recovers after obstructions. Every shot remains outdoors on the observer’s pavement. No café-interior angle, no camera beside her, no floating tracking or low fashion angle. He lowers the camera only during the final second.

blocking: The woman follows one pavement; the operator moves parallel along the opposite pavement without crossing the road. Her friend stops an arm’s length from her beside the newspaper stand. Her car is parked on her side, its left-hand driver’s door facing the roadway and visible to the observer across it.

location_map: Hotel driveway, nearby café service window, newspaper stand, litter bin and parked car form one compact route. Pedestrians and traffic occupy the foreground and middle distance. The operator retains the same side of the street throughout.

SEQUENCE LIST:

SHOT 1 (0 to 3s) — IMMEDIATE HOOK
first_frame: A yellow taxi is already sweeping across the foreground; the woman is visible beyond it at the hotel driveway.
camera: Eye-level medium-wide observation from the opposite pavement.
lens: 100mm equivalent, taxi soft in the foreground, woman clear beyond it.
camera_motion: Late corrective pan as the taxi reveals her, followed by a quick imperfect zoom.
action_visual: Within the first second, she checks her step at the driveway edge as the taxi passes. Air lifts her hair and blazer. She catches her lapel once, looks after the taxi, releases it and strides toward the nearby café. This is her only clothing-adjustment gesture in the entire scene.
reaction: Brief irritation passes across her face, then her attention moves decisively to the café.

(CUT TO)

SHOT 2 (3 to 6s) — ORDER
camera: Distant eye-level three-quarter view of her at the café’s exterior service window.
lens: 150mm equivalent, with pedestrians crossing soft in the foreground.
camera_motion: Two small sidesteps along the opposite pavement find a gap past a street pole; subtle handheld drift remains.
action_visual: She stops at the window, meets the attendant’s gaze and orders. With her right hand she passes a folded banknote from her blazer pocket to the attendant. The cup has not yet been handed to her. Other customers wait nearby.
dialog: WOMAN, after catching the attendant’s attention, says: “A coffee to go, please.”

(CUT FORWARD IN TIME TO)

SHOT 3 (6 to 9s) — COLLECT
camera: Same distant exterior viewing sector, tighter on her upper body and the service window.
lens: 190mm equivalent; enlargement comes entirely from zooming across the street.
camera_motion: A delivery van clears the foreground, revealing her; a brief focus correction finds her face.
action_visual: Later, with the previous customer gone, the attendant hands her the prepared lidded cup. She receives it in her right hand, gives him a small appreciative nod and turns back into the pavement flow. Her left forearm still carries the handbag. The preparation wait is omitted by the preceding cut.

(CUT TO)

SHOT 4 (9 to 16s) — CHANCE ENCOUNTER
camera: Eye-level distant two-shot, gradually tightening while keeping both people readable.
lens: Optical zoom from 120mm toward 180mm.
camera_motion: The operator initially follows her walking, pans slightly too far when she unexpectedly stops, then corrects and settles.
action_visual: She takes a sip while walking. A man approaching from the other direction recognizes her; they both slow, turn toward one another and STOP beside the newspaper stand. She lowers the cup. They spend the middle of this shot standing together and actually conversing. She looks at him while listening, then answers; he responds to what she says, rather than holding a frozen smile. Passersby naturally thread around them.
reaction: Recognition opens her expression into a genuine smile. A small amused exhale follows his response. At the end, she briefly touches his sleeve with her left fingertips, the bag still on that forearm, then withdraws her hand to leave.
dialog: WOMAN, recognizing him, says: “Hey! It’s been ages.”
ACQUAINTANCE, stopping and facing her, replies: “I know. How are you?”
WOMAN, after a brief listening beat, answers: “Good! Call me.”

(CUT TO)

SHOT 5 (16 to 19s) — LOSE AND FIND
camera: Eye-level observation from the same opposite pavement.
lens: Zoom pulls from 180mm toward 90mm to search.
camera_motion: A passing bus and two foreground pedestrians hide her. At 17–18s, EXACTLY ONE SECOND of chaotic handheld movement as the operator runs several steps along HIS pavement: hard footfall jolts, tilted horizon and a blurred sideways search. He remains across the road, then settles and reacquires her.
action_visual: She leaves her friend and continues through the crowd at her own steady pace. When the obstructions clear, her ivory silhouette reappears farther along the same pavement. The operator’s scramble has not changed her route or speed.

(CUT TO)

SHOT 6 (19 to 22s) — THROUGH THE CROWD
camera: Eye-level medium-long view across moving traffic.
lens: 135mm equivalent; her full movement remains readable within the busy street.
camera_motion: Handheld pan follows through gaps between passing vehicles, briefly losing part of her silhouette.
action_visual: She takes a final small sip, drops the cup into the litter bin and moves around a delivery worker carrying cartons. She gives him space with a small turn of her shoulders, then continues. Her right hand is now free. Her attention stays on navigating the street; her hair, tie and trouser legs move naturally with her stride.

(CUT TO)

SHOT 7 (22 to 25s) — REACH THE CAR
camera: Distant eye-level three-quarter view, her car initially partly hidden behind a passing taxi.
lens: 110mm equivalent, retaining her figure and the vehicle within the city.
camera_motion: A slight anticipatory pan misses her by a fraction, then corrects as the taxi clears.
action_visual: While walking, she retrieves the metal key from her handbag with her right hand. She rounds the rear of her parked car into the narrow space beside its street-facing driver’s door. By the end of the shot she has unlocked the door and put her hand on the handle. Keep this purposeful and continuous.

(CUT ON ACTION TO)

SHOT 8 (25 to 30s) — DISCOVERY AND CAMERA LOWERING
camera: Same observer across the street, eye-level medium-long framing of the woman and driver’s door.
lens: 135mm equivalent until the final downward movement; widen to 35mm as the camera is lowered.
camera_motion: A small conspicuous zoom correction catches her attention. The operator holds his distant position. At exactly 29s, he lowers the camera from his eyes and tips the lens down in one continuous physical movement.
action_visual: From 25–29s, she opens the door and briefly checks the observer across the road. Their eyes meet for less than half a second. Her lips stay closed; she gives him a cool, assessing look, turns away immediately, moves her bag into the cabin and slips into the driver’s seat. Both legs clear the doorway and she pulls the door shut. The glance, entry and closure occupy ONLY these four seconds.
From 29–30s, the same camera drops toward the operator’s own feet at the edge of his pavement. Show his charcoal trouser legs, black leather shoes and rough asphalt directly beneath him. A final handling wobble settles on his feet and the ground. End there.

Pixar-style 3D animated short, 23 seconds, 16:9, tropical island jungle with palm trees, waterfalls, turquoise lagoon, golden sunlight, ultra-detailed fur, soft cinematic lighting, vibrant colors, comedic expressive faces, smooth camera moves.

CHARACTERS: a cute chubby Polynesian toddler girl with a messy hair bun and a white flower, leaf-and-cloth outfit, big sparkling eyes; a huge majestic lion with a golden mane (the king of the jungle); a small orange-red crab named Crabby with big eyes; a fluffy white winged dragon (cat-like, glowing blue-white).

0-4s: The lion rests with eyes closed on a flat rock, tail curled in front. The toddler giggles and grabs the lion's tail while Crabby stands nearby. The lion's eyes snap wide open in shock. Wide shot: the toddler puts her hands on her hips, cheeky pose, saying "gugu gaga" while the lion stares down at her, brows furrowed.
4-8s: Crabby panics and scuttles away in a motion-blur, hides in a pink hibiscus bush with a terrified face. The lion rises slowly and stalks forward, angry. The toddler laughs and runs on all fours with Crabby racing beside her.
8-12s: Low-angle shot of the lion's huge paws behind the toddler, who sticks out her tongue playfully. They race across a wooden rope bridge, the lion running right behind them, the toddler looking back, laughing.
12-15s: They reach a cliff edge near a waterfall. The toddler jumps off screaming with a funny shocked face, holding Crabby.
15-18s: The white dragon swoops down from the sky, creating a flowing water slide through the air. The toddler splashes down and slides into the turquoise lagoon. The lion watches from the cliff top.
18-23s: The toddler lands in a huge pile of glowing pink flower petals, petals bursting into the air. The dragon lands beside her and rolls on its back laughing with legs up, Crabby beside them. The toddler's hair is blown straight up in a funny tall tuft, she laughs happily. Warm, cheerful ending.

SOUND: playful orchestral comedy score, lion roar, baby giggles, splash, whoosh, petal rustle.

NEGATIVE: text, watermark, subscribe button, distorted faces, extra limbs, flickering fur.

GLOBAL RULES: photorealistic monster chase in classical downtown Europe. Vintage handheld camcorder, muted colors, low saturation, VHS grain, gritty cinematic realism. 

A young Korean woman <<<image_1>>> escapes monsters using a transformation gun <<<image_2>>> . Every monster has a completely unique appearance, silhouette, anatomy, size, texture, and movement. Extreme high-speed action, aggressive handheld tracking, fisheye angles, whip pans, snap zooms, speed ramps, heavy motion blur, speed streaks, subtle afterimages, and rapid cuts. 

Different camera angle for every cut. The gun fires invisible projectiles with NO light, beams, or muzzle flashes, only violent recoil and gray muzzle smoke. 

Targets INSTANTLY transform on impact (under 0.5 seconds) into adorable, crystal-clear, translucent jack-o'-lantern jelly <<<image_3>>> versions of themselves in diverse vibrant colors—ruby red, emerald green, sapphire blue, amber yellow, violet, and pink. Each jack-o'-lantern jelly creature retains its original silhouette and distinctive features, with glossy gelatin surfaces, realistic light refraction, visible internal transparency, soft elastic wobbling. 

Realistic bouncing and jiggling, never floating like balloons. No slow morphing, opaque jelly, cartoon rendering, subtitles, or logos.

0–2s: Aerial quarter wide shot. Unique monsters chase her through Paris traffic.

2–5s: Frontal quarter tracking. She sprints toward camera, monsters closing in at extreme speed.

5–6.5s: Extreme left quarter close-up. She glances back and draws her gun. Snap zoom.

6.5–10s: Over-the-shoulder. She spins, fires, instantly turning a horned monster into a transparent ruby-red jack-o'-lantern  jelly <<<image_3>>> creature.

Realistic gritty Korean-thriller look, handheld film camera, natural film grain, desaturated teal-green grade. Every human, object and room surface is fully photorealistic. The doll is a real physical plush toy — real fabric, real stitching — that moves by itself like a practical puppet filmed in camera, never a cartoon or CG character. Motion blur rule: normal 180° shutter; 240–270° only on the doll's fastest dashes and on bodies flying through the air; 90–120° (crisp) at every moment of contact and on the final pose. This changes only the amount of blur, never the playback speed.

REFERENCE

@Image 1 defines <Plushie>: her face, embroidered amber eyes, black bob hair with straight bangs, the orange-flower and brass-gear headdress with dangling charms, the navy kimono with orange trim and orange flower print, the gear-buckle obi with tassels, her body proportions and fabric texture. Do not use the background, the wooden table, the sofa, the warm daylight or the composition of @Image 1.

<Plushie> is about 30 cm tall: the top of her headdress reaches only the Bald Giant's knee. She keeps exactly this size in every shot and never becomes human-sized. Her body is soft: when she is hit or lands, the fabric squashes and springs back into shape; seams and fabric pile are visible in close-ups. Her face is embroidered and never changes: the same small closed-mouth smile and unblinking amber eyes for all 30 seconds. Her legs are hidden under the kimono hem; she moves by quick little hops and skids. Her only weapons are her two tiny fabric fists and her long kimono sleeves, which she swings like heavy whips. She never speaks.

THE MEN (realistic Korean actors, text only)

<Bald Giant>: huge bald shirtless bodybuilder with a thick gold chain.

<Sweatpants Man>: shirtless, grey sweatpants.

<Bearded Man>: full beard, dark jacket.

<Sofa Man>: short hair, dark jacket, holding a glass water bottle.

<Khaki Boss>: the tallest, olive-khaki jacket, the only one who fights with skill.

A crowd of 6–8 students and men watches along the back wall and never joins the fight.

SET (all visible from the first shot, all used later)

Cold fluorescent tube lights on the ceiling are the only light source; one tube flickers. A tall wooden cabinet against the right wall throws a deep shadow. The worn grey concrete floor is covered with loose papers and chalk dust; every impact lifts papers and chalk dust into the air. Rows of wooden desks and chairs recede into depth. The classroom door is at screen left; the teal-green chalkboard and the raised teacher's platform are at screen right, deep in the room — the fight moves from the door toward the chalkboard. One toppled chair lies on the floor in the middle, knee-high: <Plushie>'s springboard. A brown leather sofa stands near the back wall.

RULES

- The camera always films from the side and never crosses the line. <Plushie> stays on screen left facing right. Every man attacks from screen right toward screen left, and every man she hits flies toward screen right, deeper into the room.

- The camera never stops moving, except a 2-frame freeze on each clean contact (hit-stop); then it follows the recoil once and settles.

- Base camera height is <Plushie>'s eye level, about 30 cm above the floor, so the men tower over the frame. Base lens 50 mm. 85–135 mm telephoto only to compress her fast dashes. 24–28 mm low wide only for throws, with her kept near the center of frame.

- Slow motion exactly twice: the bottle at 12–15s and the final throw at 24–27s.

- The single strongest camera shake is saved for the final slam.

- The comedy is contrast: she never reacts, gloats or poses. She hits with the same calm smile, while every impact looks and sounds brutally heavy.

TIMELINE

Flow: mockery → she tips over → the giant flies → three men fall one by one → she walks through the wreck → the boss flattens her → she puffs back into shape → final throw onto the platform → stare.

0–3.5s: <Plushie> stands still on the concrete floor near the door, head slightly lowered, sleeves hanging. <Bald Giant> walks in from screen right grinning, crouches, and flicks her forehead with one finger. She tips over backward, her fabric squashes against the floor, then she rocks upright again like a roly-poly toy, charms jingling. The crowd laughs. Camera: slow ground-level push-in toward her face at her eye level; the giant's huge knees and hand enter the frame out of focus. Sharp: her embroidered eyes. Soft: the giant's grinning face above. Sound: crowd laughter, a tiny jingle of her charms, fluorescent buzz.

End state: <Plushie> upright, the giant's finger still in front of her face.

3.5–6s: She grabs the giant's index finger with both tiny hands and twists her whole body. Hit-stop. The giant flips over in a full arc and crashes back-first onto a row of student desks at screen right, then slides to the floor, arms spread, motionless, gold chain on his chest. Papers and chalk dust explode. Camera: low 24 mm wide that cranes up with his arc and ends looking down at him from a high angle. Sharp: the finger in her grip at contact. Soft: the shocked crowd. Sound: deep body slam, splintering wood; the laughter stops dead.

End state: giant motionless at screen right among broken desks; <Plushie> on the floor at screen left, same smile.

6–9s: <Sweatpants Man> charges from screen right with a roar and swings a kick at her like a football. She hops onto the toppled chair, springs off it to his face height, spins, and whips her long right sleeve across his jaw — the sleeve hits like a steel bar. Hit-stop. His head snaps sideways, a chair flies through the air, he slams into the right wall beside the cabinet and slides down it, dazed. Camera: telephoto lateral tracking that matches her speed for one beat during the hop, then holds on the contact. Sharp: sleeve and jaw at contact. Soft: the wall behind. Sound: soft fabric whoosh, then a hard crack.

End state: <Plushie> lands softly on the floor, squashes and springs back.

9–12s: <Bearded Man> bends low and lunges to grab her with both hands. She ducks between his hands, grabs his jacket collar, drops backward and throws him over her head in a fast motion-blurred arc. He crashes onto the desks at screen right; papers explode into the air. Camera: short low orbit of about 90 degrees around her during the throw, 28 mm, ending side-on again. Sharp: her grip on the collar. Soft: the flying papers. Sound: whoosh, heavy crash, desks scraping.

End state: bearded man sprawled on the desks; <Plushie> standing at screen left.

12–15s (slow motion 1 of 2): Near the brown leather sofa, <Sofa Man> snatches her by the head and lifts her to his face, laughing, the glass bottle raised in his other hand. She wriggles free, and in mid-air whips her sleeve into the bottle, smashing it against his own forehead — slow-motion burst of water and glass shards under the flickering light. He collapses backward onto the sofa, unconscious. She lands on the sofa's armrest. Camera: slow push-in at his face height, the only shot above her eye level before the finale. Sharp: bottle, glass and water droplets. Soft: his face behind the burst. Sound: muffled and stretched during the slow motion, then the glass crash snaps back at full volume.

End state: <Sofa Man> limp on the sofa; <Plushie> on the armrest.

15–18s: She hops down and walks calmly toward the chalkboard between toppled chairs and groaning men; her sleeves and headdress charms swing with each little hop; the crowd backs away. Camera: ground-level tracking dolly beside her, same speed, the flicker passing over her. Sharp: <Plushie>. Soft: the fallen men in the background. Sound: soft "pof, pof" steps, tiny jingle, low drone.

End state: <Plushie> in the middle of the room, facing right.

18–21s: <Khaki Boss> steps out of the crowd from screen right, roars, and drives a full-weight punch straight down onto her. His fist flattens her into a pancake against the concrete — fabric pressed flat, not torn. The crowd cheers. Camera: high oblique angle from beside his right shoulder, looking down along his arm onto the fist. Sharp: fist and flattened fabric. Soft: the cheering crowd. Sound: heavy thud, cheers.

End state: his fist still pressed on the flattened doll.

21–24s: One beat of silence. Her flattened fabric puffs back into full shape under his fist with a soft "fwump", pushing his fist up. She counterattacks at once: a tiny fist into his elbow, a sleeve whip into his knee — he buckles — then a headbutt into his ribs with the brass gears of her headdress. Hit-stop on each contact. Camera: low handheld follow at her eye level, from the side. Sharp: each contact point in turn: elbow, knee, ribs. Soft: the crowd. Sound: "fwump", then three heavy thuds.

End state: <Khaki Boss> down on one knee, bent over, his face now at her height.

24–27s (slow motion 2 of 2, one unbroken take): She grabs his jacket collar with both hands, plants herself and throws him over her head in a huge arc toward screen right. A moment of total silence at the top of the arc. He slams back-first onto the teacher's platform in front of the chalkboard; the chalkboard cracks and falls flat onto the floor; chalk dust bursts. The strongest camera shake of the film, once, then it settles. Camera: one continuous take, low 24 mm wide from her eye level, tilting up to follow his arc overhead, then pulling back as he lands — no cut. Sharp: her grip, then his landing. Soft: the crowd. Final layout: <Khaki Boss> lying on the platform at screen right beside the fallen chalkboard; <Plushie> standing at screen left of center.

27–30s: Wide aftermath. The men lie scattered among overturned chairs and papers; thin chalk dust hangs under the flickering lights; the crowd is frozen. <Plushie> straightens her headdress with one hand, pats chalk dust off her sleeve, then slowly turns to face the camera — the same small smile, the same embroidered amber eyes — and tilts her head about 10 degrees. Hold on her face. Camera: very slow push-in from wide to a close-up of her face at her eye level, still drifting slightly at the end. End.

AUDIO

No dialogue; only the men's roars, laughter and cheers. Sound effects are louder than ambience. Strength order: final slam onto the platform > bottle shatter > the giant crashing into the desks > all other hits > ambience. Her own sounds stay tiny and soft: fabric "pof" steps, a light metal jingle of her charms — the contrast is the joke. A deep low cinematic drone under the fight. Total silence just before the final slam. The ending is silence with the faint buzz of the fluorescent lights and one last jingle.

NEGATIVE

No text, subtitles, logos or watermark. No anime, cartoon or CG-render look on the room or the men. The doll never turns human, never grows, has no animated mouth, never blinks, never changes expression, never tears or loses stuffing, never changes outfit or headdress, no extra limbs. No blood.
